aiMetadata.description: Creates a new email campaign in Elastic Email targeting the given mailing lists and/or segments, with sender, subject, template, and an initial status (e.g. draft or active). Use to set up a bulk campaign send; for one-off transactional messages use Send Email instead. Each call creates a separate campaign, so it is not idempotent.

create_contact.name: create_contact
create_contact.description: Create a new contact in Elastic Email.

email.description: The email address of the contact.

customFields.description: Key-value pairs of custom contact fields. Only existing custom fields will be saved.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new contact in Elastic Email from an email address, with optional name, status, and custom fields, without attaching it to any mailing list. Use when you only need the contact to exist; use Add Contact to Mailing List when it must also join specific lists. Each call appends the contact, so it is not idempotent.

create_segment.name: create_segment
create_segment.description: Create a new contact segment in Elastic Email using a SQL-like rule.

rule.description: SQL-like rule to determine which contacts belong to this segment. See https://help.elasticemail.com/en/articles/5162182-segment-rules

aiMetadata.description: Creates a named contact segment in Elastic Email defined by a SQL-like rule that selects which contacts belong to it. Use to build a reusable audience for campaigns. The rule must follow Elastic Email segment-rule syntax. Each call creates a separate segment, so it is not idempotent.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return (max 100).

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a paginated list of contacts from the Elastic Email account using limit and offset. Use to browse or page through contacts. Read-only and idempotent.

merge.description: Key-value merge fields shared between recipients. Use in email body like {firstname}, {lastname}.

aiMetadata.description: Sends a transactional email to one or more recipients via Elastic Email, with either inline body content or a saved template, plus optional merge fields, tracking, and a scheduled time offset. Use for direct one-off sends; use Create Campaign for bulk list/segment marketing. Each call dispatches a new email, so it is not idempotent.

aiMetadata.description: Marks one or more email addresses as unsubscribed in Elastic Email so they no longer receive future emails. Use to honor opt-out or suppression requests. Idempotent: re-running with the same addresses leaves them unsubscribed with no additional effect.
